arStrings.szText: "Have you ever seen anything like this?"
Well, it ain’t a creation of Hatred. Looks like a witch's talisman...though you couldn't prove it by me.
Thinking aloud. Vexed. Hesitant to confirm a witch made it.
I'd better take it back to the Tree, have the ladies take a look. You keep following those whispers, eh? You never know what else might turn up.
A touch of denial. Projecting confidence.
